Patch Set 7:

(3 comments)

Experimental feature testing in progress, please pay attention to the comments

The feature logic looks correct: the FILE* handles are closed on every path, the .lgss header/principal parsing is sound, and relocating the mgsname auto-generation block before the GSS section correctly stops the new `goto append` paths from skipping it (the conf-sanity test_161 breakage seen on an earlier patchset).

One change-wide note: this adds user-visible functionality (reading krb5princ from .lgss with its own validation logic) but no dedicated regression test. Could sanity-krb5 gain a subtest that drops a `krb5princ=<SPN>` .lgss into a mount point and checks it is picked up (and that a malformed one is rejected)?

Also, `Test-Parameters: trivial` is still present alongside the real testgroups; a change to mount.lustre parsing isn't really trivial. This was raised on an earlier patchset and looks unaddressed.

commit.subject: LU-19079 krb: use .lgss to specify principal
commit.message:
LU-19079 krb: use .lgss to specify principal

Allow the .lgss file inside the client mount point to contain a
reference to the Kerberos principal to use, with the syntax:
krb5princ=<full Service Principal Name>

This is an alternative to the 'krb5princ' mount option, designed for
easier automated implementation.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity
Test-Parameters: testgroup=review-dne-selinux-ssk-part-1
Test-Parameters: testgroup=review-dne-selinux-ssk-part-2
